end.summary:
Practised andar/bahar with containers; 5/5 responses were unaided and correct.
Practised upar/neeche and on/under; 4/4 responses were unaided and correct.
Practised paas/door by comparing with a reference object; 4/5 responses were unaided and correct.
Near/far was once treated as a property of the object rather than a comparison, and this was not corrected by the last seen attempt.
end.parentNote: Shaurya practised position words using objects and picture situations. They used andar/bahar and upar/neeche consistently; the comparison method worked for most paas/door examples. One mix-up was treating near or far as belonging to the object itself, and it was not yet corrected later in the lesson. At home, place two objects in different positions and ask, “What is near the cup?” or “What is far from the cup?”
